title: Freeport-McMoRan Q2 2026 results exhibit
excerpt: Q2 adjusted EPS was USD 0.74, copper sales were 710 million pounds, realization was USD 6.17 per pound and unit net cash cost was USD 1.97 per pound.
summary: The unchanged SEC-filed Q2 exhibit remains the latest operating evidence for production, sales, realized prices, unit costs, earnings, cash flow, capital spending, net debt, the Grasberg recovery and Indonesian operating-rights analysis.
